qazpipe.rationale: Product-owned fetchers retain source-specific attribution, opt-in and failure semantics.

qazlake.rationale: The public map reads self-hosted runtime projections; no QazLake consumer contract is configured.

qazcompute.rationale: Optional product-owned analysis remains behind local operator controls.

qazgeo.rationale: Geocoding is a product-owned provider boundary with its own attribution and privacy controls.

identity.rationale: The public dashboard has no account system; privileged operations use the local-operator boundary.

dataBoundary.publicProjection: Public OSINT map layers and health summaries only.
dataBoundary.privateBoundary: Operator credentials, recon controls, private mesh lanes and diagnostics are not public projections.

schemaValidation.reason: The Platform schema endpoint requires an authenticated registry session as observed on 2026-08-23.
